verdict.rationale: Decagon is a SaaS platform for building customer-service agents, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The only MCP evidence is a blog post on MCP as a general way to package and expose tools, and on Decagon curating how its own agents use tools. That is client-side tool consumption, not a documented first-party Decagon MCP server that external agents can connect to. No API spec was found either: all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
